claim: Grokking replicates across seeds (companion project's 11 runs)
published: grokking with wd = 1 on a 30% split (Nanda et al. 2023, one run)
ours: 11/11 seeds reach > 99% test accuracy; test-95% step ÷ train-99% step: median 57.2× (min 32.2×)
criterion: ≥ 9 of 11 seeds grok, with delay ≥ 3× in each

claim: A handful of key frequencies and single-frequency neurons in every seed
ours: key frequencies per seed: 3–6; median 81.6% of neurons > 85% FVE
criterion: 3–7 key frequencies in every seed and median single-frequency fraction > 60%

claim: Controls: no weight decay / random labels don't generalize
published: no grokking without regularization; nothing to learn with random labels
ours: wd = 0: best final test acc 21.5% over 5 runs; random labels: 0.9% over 3
criterion: every wd = 0 run < 50% and every random-label run < 5% test accuracy
